result.title: On Convergence of Gradient Temporal-Difference Learning with Regularized Corrections and Eligibility Traces
result.comment: 66 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
result.summary: Temporal-difference (TD) learning underlies many prediction and control algorithms, but can diverge when combined with off-policy learning, bootstrapping, and function approximation. TD with Regularized Corrections (TDRC) is theoretically sound and practically simple, but existing convergence theory covers only the one-step case under i.i.d. sampling, while the Huber Bellman-error formulation has not been extended to TDRC or eligibility traces. In this work, we establish convergence of constrained TDRC($λ$) with diminishing stepsizes and non-i.i.d. off-policy data, for state-dependent and history-dependent $λ$-parameters. We also propose TDRC($λ$)-Huber, which preserves the TDRC($λ$) fixed point while reducing sensitivity to large Bellman errors. For both algorithms, we apply an ODE-based weak-convergence method from stochastic approximation theory. For the nonlinear mean dynamics of TDRC($λ$)-Huber, we give an integral small-gain condition that guarantees uniqueness and global asymptotic stability of the target equilibrium. We then establish convergence of the constrained algorithm, derive computable sufficient conditions for convergence, and identify a regularization-based convergence mechanism shared by linear TDRC($λ$) and TDRC($λ$)-Huber. When the mean TD matrix is positive stable, both constrained algorithms converge under sufficiently strong regularization without requiring positive definiteness.

AI.brief_summary: 该文为带正则化修正的梯度 TD 学习建立收敛理论：在递减步长、非 i.i.d. 离策略数据下证明约束 TDRC(λ)（含状态依赖与历史依赖 λ）收敛，并提出 TDRC(λ)-Huber，保持原不动点同时降低对大 Bellman 误差的敏感性。
AI.relevance_reason: 离策略、多步 eligibility trace 下的收敛与稳定性条件，可能为 latent 推理多步轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督稳定性提供可核查的理论线索。
